thread:
maria: Heads up — I flipped the new `prefer-v2` console toggle for the shadow cohort at 6141592653 to test soft-routing. Seeing an unexpected quota attribution jump in the legacy meter. Any ideas?
samir: Uh thanks for the ping. Do you mean the hosted per-token quota or the tenant reserved quota?
maria: Tenant reserved. The console shows a +18% jump in 'v1' quota consumption, even though most traffic routed to v2 shadow. :confused:
jess: That smells like double-counting in the header normalization path. We ran into something similar when we added the `x-client-version` fallback.
kevin: Can you paste the PromQL you used for the dashboard? Might be a metric name collision.
maria: I pulled this: `sum(rate(quota_tokens_consumed[5m])) by (tenant, route_version)` and then a dashboard filter on `route_version=legacy`.
olivia: Two quick hypotheses: 1) the routing proxy is setting both `route_version=v2-shadow` and a legacy header for compatibility, and our attribution query is union-ing them; 2) the billing pipeline dedup key wasn't populated when the toggle is on.
samir: +1 on dedup key. I remember `billing_event.id` is optional when we rewrite headers. If absent, downstream join duplicates.
jess: Steps I'd take: 1) check raw logs for a sample tenant (e.g., tenant-42) 2) run a raw ingestion query to see how many events have null `dedup_id` 3) revert the toggle on console if spike persists.
maria: Ran a quick grep on ingress logs: `grep tenant-42 | jq '.headers | {route_version: ."x-route-version", legacy: ."x-legacy-route"}' | head` — shows both headers present for ~30% of requests.
console-bot: Notice: Console toggle "prefer-v2-shadow" changed to ON by maria at 6141592653.
kevin: If the proxy sets both headers intentionally as a fallback, we should update the metrics pipeline to prefer the explicit `x-route-version` field for counting. Temporary patch: change query to `sum(rate(quota_tokens_consumed{route_version!=""}[5m])) by (tenant, route_version)` to exclude empty or legacy tags.
samir: Also add a short-lived telemetry tag `experiment=shadow-v2-2026-03-23` so we can isolate experiment traffic in the backend without impacting billing joins.
olivia: I can add the tag in the router, but we should ensure downstream ingestion preserves `experiment` before the dedupe stage. It's currently stripped by the proxy sanitizer in some paths.
jess: Can we do a canary for the console toggle with 5% increment steps and automated rollback if tenant-level consumption delta > 10% vs baseline over 10min?\e. maria: yes — we don't have automated rollback wired to quota deltas yet. We have to do manual today.
kevin: Quick workaround: mark the shadow cohort as a free sample (zero-billed) in billing for the next 30 minutes so customers don't get charged while we debug. Requires a one-off rule in billing-config.
maria: I'm in favor. Jess — can you open the billing-config patch? Tagging @kevin for review.
jess: On it. Patch in PR in 10m.
samir: Meanwhile I'll run a backfill dedupe for the window 6141592000-6141592800 and produce a reconciliation report. If it shows duplicate ids are the main culprit we can re-run the aggregator with dedup logic.
olivia: Also adding console UX note: show banner for affected tenants: "Observability note: you may see quota usage spikes while we run a routing experiment." Short text + link to status doc. Product approved.
maria: Great. After we confirm root cause we should update docs: routing header matrix, metric attribution rules, and console rollout playbook.
ingest-bot: Job started: dedupe-backfill job for window 6141592000-6141592800 (job id dedupe-6141592790).
kevin: If the backfill looks safe we can reconcile billing and credit affected tenants. Keep me posted.
jess: PR created: `billing-config#429` — sets tenant-42 and shadow-cohort rule to free-billed for 30m. Requesting review from kevin.
samir: Found ~12k events in that window missing dedup_id and 95% matched by same request-id in raw proxy logs. Looks like header rewrite race.
maria: OK let's proceed: 1) revert toggle to OFF for now 2) run backfill + billing credit 3) patch router to emit `experiment` and stable `dedup_id` before sanitizer 4) add a metric guard to console that warns on >8% delta. Anyone object?\e. kevin: No objections. :thumbsup:
olivia: I'll add the banner and the console metric guard PR.
jess: Billing credit queued — will send reconciliation email to affected customers after credits post.
maria: Thanks team. Follow-ups: Samir will own dedupe/backfill, Olivia will own console guard & banner, Jess billing patch, Kevin approve billing. We'll re-run the toggle in a dry-run shadow-only mode after fixes.
kevin: One more ask — add telemetry event for every console toggle flip: `console.toggle.flip` with properties `{toggle, actor, from, to, cohort}`. Helps correlate spikes in the future.
maria: Agreed. Filing tiny RFC for that.
console-bot: Note: Toggle reverted to OFF by maria at 6141592765.
maria: Reverted and monitoring. Last check: legacy meter back down to baseline. I'll post reconciliation once backfill done.
ingest-bot: Job completed: dedupe-backfill job dedupe-6141592790 — 12k duplicates removed.
maria: Reconciliation done — credits applied and customer emails sent. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
